questions.q: I want ___ apple and a banana.
questions.explain: apple 以元音（a, e, i, o, u）開頭，單數前要用不定冠詞 an。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: I want ___ apple and a banana.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 1A–1B: Articles, Demonstratives & Pronouns

questions.q: Look at ___ bird in the sky! It is far away.
questions.explain: 指遠處的單數物件或動物（bird）時，使用指示代詞 that。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Look at ___ bird in the sky! It is far away.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 1A–1B: Articles, Demonstratives & Pronouns

questions.q: ___ are my colour pencils here in my hand.
questions.explain: 指近處的複數物件（colour pencils）時，使用指示代詞 These。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ are my colour pencils here in my hand.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 1A–1B: Articles, Demonstratives & Pronouns

questions.q: This is my brother. ___ name is Leo.
questions.explain: brother 是男孩，表示「他的」要用物主形容詞 His。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: This is my brother. ___ name is Leo.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 1A–1B: Articles, Demonstratives & Pronouns

questions.q: Our English teacher is very kind. We all like ___ (she / her).
questions.explain: 動詞 like 後面要用受格代詞（object pronoun），女性用 her。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Our English teacher is very kind. We all like ___ (she / her).
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 1A–1B: Articles, Demonstratives & Pronouns

questions.q: Fill in the article (a / an): There is ___ elephant in the zoo.
questions.explain: elephant 以元音 e 開頭，單數前用 an。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Fill in the article (a / an): There is ___ elephant in the zoo.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 1A–1B: Articles, Demonstratives & Pronouns

questions.q: We use 'this' for one thing near us and 'that' for one thing far away.
questions.explain: this 指近處單數，that 指遠處單數。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: We use 'this' for one thing near us and 'that' for one thing far away.

questions.q: Rearrange the words to form a correct sentence.
questions.explain: 正確句序：This is my new eraser.（這是我的新橡皮擦。）
